ad_library.summary: Mega Creations trades as Mega Solar India and runs 2 live Google ads behind an identity-verified account. The homepage pitch is a genuine Hyderabad residential-installer one - Rs.78,000 PM Surya Ghar subsidy, no-upfront-cost and pay-as-you-save financing, 7-day installation, 25-year warranty, and Waaree / Adani / Premier / Panasonic / Polycab / Microtek named as partners. The contact page behind it is an unedited WordPress demo: example.com addresses, a Brooklyn address, +1 123-456-7890 and a preschool enquiry form. Two live ads, and nothing for the click to land on.

defects.title: The contact page is an unedited WordPress demo
defects.detail: megasolarindia.com/contact/ opens with 'Have questions about our programs?' followed by the lorem-ipsum line 'fells mauris quisque scelerisque, porta placerat pharetra'. It publishes info@example.com, enrollment@example.com and collab@example.com under headings 'General', 'Parents' and 'Vendor'; the address is 'Demo St, Brooklyn, NY 11223, United States'; the phones are +1 123-456-7890 and +1 123-456-7891; and the form asks for a 'Parent's Name' and whether the question is about 'Infant', 'Toddler' or 'Preschool'. A homeowner who clicks a paid ad and tries to make contact lands on a preschool enquiry form in Brooklyn.

defects.title: No real email or phone anywhere on the site
defects.detail: Every address and number published is a demo placeholder. The only live contact path is a script-rendered WhatsApp chat widget, so nothing is captured in writing.

defects.title: 57 of 103 homepage images carry no alt text
defects.detail: The page repeats whole sections - the six brand logos appear twice, the 'Customer Love Us!' testimonial block three times, the 'Recent Projects' gallery three times - and only the first pass carries any alt text at all.

defects.title: Theme pages left live and indexed
defects.detail: /admission/ and /sample-page/ are in the sitemap - leftovers from the demo theme, not a solar business.

defects.title: The default WordPress post is live
defects.detail: /hello-world/ is published and in the sitemap.

defects.title: Two live creatives, one landing page
defects.detail: Both Google ads point at the same homepage, so there is no second page to test a different offer or price against.

defects.title: A Prime Minister's quote stands in for customer proof
defects.detail: The only named testimonial on the homepage is a stock photo of PM Narendra Modi over a generic renewable-energy quote, sitting under a '100% of customers recommend us!' heading whose six testimonial images are unnamed files.
